verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so a PCI-scope-reducing PAN/CVV reveal is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents card issuance, wallet tokenization and 3DS, but nothing on hosted card-data components, ephemeral-key reveal flows, or SAQ D scope. Wallet tokenization is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
